title_zh: 转达脚跟伤口与免疫状况并等候回电

scenario.label_zh: 请求诊所回电脚跟伤口问题
scenario.goal_zh: 向接待员描述脚跟伤口未愈合及担忧，要求将免疫状况一并转交护士并确认回电安排

context_zh: 患者给诊所打电话转达症状，接待员不作诊断。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Aaron
sentences.text: I have a sore on my heel, and it doesn't seem to heal. Could I speak to a nurse?

sentences.speaker: Jo
sentences.text: I'll pass on a message. How long has it been there?

sentences.speaker: Aaron
sentences.text: About a week. I'm worried about an infection, but I don't know if that's what it is.

sentences.speaker: Jo
sentences.text: I'll include that concern. Is there anything else you want the nurse to know?

sentences.speaker: Aaron
sentences.text: Yes. My doctor says my treatment affects my immune system. Please put that in the message too.

sentences.speaker: Jo
sentences.text: I will. I'll ask the nurse to review your message and call you today. Can you answer on this number?

sentences.speaker: Aaron
sentences.text: Yes, I'll keep the phone with me. Thank you.

targets.sense_zh: 与身体免疫防御有关的
